snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Mii Fighter Costumes #9 - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
New Mii Fighter costumes from the Monster Hunter series and Ghosts ’n Goblins are now available as Super Smash Bros. Ultimate DLC!

Hunter Equipment (Swordfighter)
Rathalos Equipment (Swordfighter)
Felyne (Hat)
Arthur (Swordfighter)

#SmashBrosUltimate #MonsterHunter
